stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: May is Peter's aunt, who raises him with Ben in Queens. After Ben's death, the Green Goblin attacks her in her home and puts her in the hospital.
stages.whoA: His aunt, who raised him with Uncle Ben.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, whom she raised with Ben.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: With May about to lose her house, Peter confesses his part in Ben's death. She is shaken at first, then forgives him.
stages.whoA: His aunt. She forgives him for his part in Ben's death.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, who confesses his part in Ben's death.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: May gives Peter her engagement ring so he can propose to Mary Jane. When they learn who really killed Ben, she warns him against revenge.
stages.whoA: His aunt, who gives him her ring to propose.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, who plans to propose with her ring.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Ben is Peter's uncle, who raises him with May. He tells Peter that with great power comes great responsibility, and that same night he is shot by a carjacker.
stages.whoA: His uncle, killed the night Peter let a thief escape.
stages.whoB: His nephew, whom he raised and taught about responsibility.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mary Jane is the girl next door Peter has loved since childhood. Spider-Man saves her twice, and when she tells Peter she loves him, he says they can only be friends to keep her safe.
stages.whoA: The girl next door he loves, kept at a distance.
stages.whoB: Her neighbor and friend, who says they can only be friends.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Peter keeps Mary Jane at arm's length, and she gets engaged to John Jameson. After Doc Ock kidnaps her and she learns Peter is Spider-Man, she leaves her wedding to be with him.
stages.whoA: His love. She learns his secret and leaves her wedding for him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the man she leaves her wedding for.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Peter plans to propose, but the symbiote's pull and Harry's threats drive them apart. After Peter saves her from Venom and the Sandman, they share a dance at the jazz club.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend. They are torn apart, then share a dance.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend. They are torn apart, then share a dance.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Harry is Peter's best friend. He dates Mary Jane, and after his father's death he vows revenge on Spider-Man, never guessing it is Peter.
stages.whoA: His best friend, who vows revenge on Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: His best friend, who is secretly Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Harry resents Peter's loyalty to Spider-Man and trades Doc Ock tritium for the hero. When he unmasks his captive and finds Peter, he still tells him where to find Otto.
stages.whoA: His best friend, who unmasks him.
stages.whoB: His best friend, the Spider-Man he blames for his father's death.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Harry attacks Peter as the New Goblin, then loses his memory in a fall. When it returns, he forces Mary Jane to leave Peter, and their next fight scars his face.
stages.whoA: His old best friend, now the New Goblin.
stages.whoB: His former best friend, whom he blames for his father's death.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: When Bernard tells Harry the truth about Norman's death, Harry joins Peter to save Mary Jane. He takes a glider blade meant for Peter and dies at peace with him.
stages.whoA: His best friend, who dies saving him.
stages.whoB: His best friend again, whom he dies saving.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Norman Osborn is Harry's father, and he takes a liking to Peter. As the Green Goblin, he learns Peter is Spider-Man, attacks May and drops Mary Jane from a bridge, then dies on his own glider, begging Peter not to tell Harry.
stages.whoA: Harry's father, the Green Goblin.
stages.whoB: His son's best friend, the Spider-Man he cannot break.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world just before his death, Norman faces Peter again at the Statue of Liberty. Peter stops the other Peter from killing him and takes the Goblin's glider in the back, and Peter's own anti-serum cures Norman.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin again. Peter spares him and cures him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man from his own world, who spares him and cures him.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Otto Octavius is a brilliant scientist Peter admires. Over dinner with Otto and his wife, Rosie, Otto befriends Peter and offers him advice on love and science.
stages.whoA: A scientist he admires, who befriends and advises him.
stages.whoB: A bright young student he befriends and advises.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: After the accident, Otto's arms drive him to rob a bank, kidnap Mary Jane and hand Spider-Man over to Harry. Peter unmasks and reminds him what he once believed, and Otto drowns his reactor, dying with it.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, his fallen mentor.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who brings him back to himself.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled across worlds, Otto fights another Peter until a new inhibitor chip restores him. At the Statue of Liberty, he helps cure Electro and has a warm reunion with his old friend Peter.
stages.whoA: Otto, his old friend, restored and fighting beside him.
stages.whoB: Peter, grown up, and still his friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Flint Marko is an escaped convict who becomes the Sandman, and Peter learns he is the real killer of Uncle Ben. Marko teams with Venom to kill Spider-Man, but in the end he says Ben's death was an accident, and Peter forgives him.
stages.whoA: The Sandman, Uncle Ben's real killer, whom he forgives.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who forgives him for Ben's death.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, Marko only wants to get home to his daughter. At the Statue of Liberty, Peter cures him and turns him back into a man.
stages.whoA: The Sandman again, whom he cures.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man from his own world, who cures him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Peter meets another Peter Parker, a Spider-Man from a different world, when both are pulled into a third. They bond over the people they lost and help that world's Peter cure the villains.
stages.whoA: Another Peter Parker, from another world, and a brother in arms.
stages.whoB: Another Peter Parker, an older Spider-Man who becomes his friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Eddie Brock is a rival photographer competing with Peter for a staff job at the Daily Bugle. When Peter exposes his faked photo of Spider-Man, Eddie is fired and wants revenge.
stages.whoA: A rival photographer he gets fired.
stages.whoB: A rival photographer who exposes his fake.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: The symbiote Peter tears off bonds with Eddie, who becomes Venom and teams with the Sandman to kill Spider-Man. Peter frees him from it with sound, but Eddie leaps back toward the symbiote and dies in the blast.
stages.whoA: Venom, wearing the symbiote he cast off.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whose cast off symbiote makes him Venom.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson hires Peter as a freelance photographer for the Daily Bugle. He buys Peter's pictures of Spider-Man while calling the hero a menace.
stages.whoA: His boss at the Bugle, who hates Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: His freelance photographer, who always gets Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Dr. Curt Connors is Peter's physics professor at Columbia, and he presses his gifted but struggling student to keep up.
stages.whoA: His physics professor at Columbia.
stages.whoB: His gifted, struggling physics student.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Peter brings Connors a sample of the black symbiote, and Connors warns him that it amplifies aggression.
stages.whoA: His professor, who warns him about the symbiote.
stages.whoB: His student, who brings him the alien symbiote.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Ursula is the shy daughter of Peter's landlord. While he struggles, she is kind to him and brings him treats.
stages.whoA: His landlord's shy daughter, who is kind to him.
stages.whoB: Her father's struggling tenant, whom she looks after.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Gwen Stacy is Peter's lab partner, and he tutors her. After Spider-Man saves her, she kisses him at a ceremony, and later she sees Peter is using her to make Mary Jane jealous.
stages.whoA: His lab partner, whom he uses to hurt Mary Jane.
stages.whoB: Her lab partner and tutor, who uses her to hurt Mary Jane.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Captain George Stacy is Gwen's father. He tells Peter and May that Flint Marko, not the carjacker, killed Ben.
stages.whoA: Gwen's father, who tells him who really killed Ben.
stages.whoB: His daughter's lab partner, whom he tells about Ben's killer.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Out of spite, Peter lets a thief run past him, and the same man later kills Uncle Ben. Peter chases him down, and the thief falls to his death.
stages.whoA: The thief he let go, who then killed Uncle Ben.
stages.whoB: The young man who let him escape, then hunted him.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Peter learns this man was only the accomplice in the carjacking, and that Flint Marko fired the shot that killed Ben.
stages.whoA: The thief he let go, only an accomplice in Ben's death.
stages.whoB: The young man who chased him to his death.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: John Jameson is the astronaut son of Peter's boss, and he is engaged to Mary Jane. Peter hides his own feelings while John plans the wedding she walks out on.
stages.whoA: Jameson's astronaut son, engaged to the woman Peter loves.
stages.whoB: Mary Jane's old friend, who quietly loves her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: May and Ben are a married couple who raise their nephew Peter in Queens. Ben is shot dead by a carjacker, leaving May a widow.
stages.whoA: Her husband, shot dead by a carjacker.
stages.whoB: His wife, who raises Peter with him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mary Jane lives next door to the Parkers and is a friend of the family. She visits May in the hospital after the Goblin's attack.
stages.whoA: The girl next door, a friend of the family.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt next door, a family friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Norman joins the Parkers for Thanksgiving and works out that Peter is Spider-Man. Soon after, the Green Goblin attacks May in her home and puts her in the hospital.
stages.whoA: Harry's father, the Goblin who attacks her at home.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt, attacked to hurt Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Doc Ock takes May hostage during a bank robbery, and she fights back with her umbrella until Spider-Man saves her.
stages.whoA: Doc Ock, who takes her hostage in a bank robbery.
stages.whoB: A hostage he takes in a bank robbery.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Harry dates Mary Jane, but he sees that she is falling for Peter, and it hurts him.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend, Peter's best friend.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, who is falling for Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Mary Jane and Harry grow close again while Peter is distant, and they share a kiss she regrets. Once his memory returns, Harry forces her to leave Peter, but he dies helping save her from Venom.
stages.whoA: Her old friend, who forces her breakup, then dies saving her.
stages.whoB: His old friend, whom he forces to leave Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Norman looks down on Mary Jane, his son's girlfriend. As the Green Goblin, he drops her from the Queensboro Bridge to test Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Harry's father, the Goblin who drops her from a bridge.
stages.whoB: His son's girlfriend, a pawn against Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Doc Ock kidnaps Mary Jane to make Peter find Spider-Man. Held in his lair, she learns that Peter is the hero.
stages.whoA: Doc Ock, who kidnaps her to get to Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: His hostage, bait for Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: The Sandman and Venom take Mary Jane hostage to lure Spider-Man into a trap.
stages.whoA: The Sandman, who holds her hostage with Venom.
stages.whoB: A hostage he helps take to trap Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Eddie Brock, now Venom, kidnaps Mary Jane to lure Spider-Man to his death.
stages.whoA: Venom, who kidnaps her to lure Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Peter's love, kidnapped as bait.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Mary Jane is hurt when Gwen kisses Spider-Man at his ceremony. When Peter brings Gwen to the jazz club to make her jealous, Gwen sees what is happening, apologizes to Mary Jane and leaves.
stages.whoA: Peter's lab partner, whose kiss with Spider-Man hurts her.
stages.whoB: Peter's ex, to whom she apologizes.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Mary Jane gets engaged to astronaut John Jameson. Realizing she loves Peter, she runs out on their wedding.
stages.whoA: Her fiance, whom she leaves at the altar.
stages.whoB: His fiancee, who leaves him at the altar.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Norman Osborn is Harry's father, a demanding man Harry tries hard to please. After Norman's death, Harry blames Spider-Man and vows revenge.
stages.whoA: His father, whose approval he always seeks.
stages.whoB: His son, who rarely lives up to his hopes.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Bernard is the Osborn family's butler, serving Harry and his father.
stages.whoA: The family butler.
stages.whoB: The son of the house he serves.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Bernard finally tells Harry that Norman was killed by his own glider, not by Spider-Man, and Harry goes to help Peter.
stages.whoA: His butler, who tells him how Norman really died.
stages.whoB: The young master he finally tells the truth.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Bernard serves Norman Osborn as the family's butler, and he knows how Norman really died.
stages.whoA: His butler.
stages.whoB: His employer, the head of the Osborn house.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Harry's Oscorp funds Otto's fusion work. After the accident, Otto dangles Harry from a balcony for more tritium, and Harry trades it for the capture of Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The scientist he funds, then trades tritium for Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: His funder, who trades him tritium for Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Harry joins Peter in the fight to save Mary Jane and battles the Sandman.
stages.whoA: The Sandman, whom he fights beside Peter.
stages.whoB: The New Goblin, who fights him beside Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Venom tries to impale Spider-Man with Harry's glider, and Harry throws himself in the way. The wound kills him.
stages.whoA: Venom, whose blow with his glider kills him.
stages.whoB: The New Goblin, killed by his own glider.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Rosie is Otto's wife and his partner in his work. She is killed when his fusion demonstration goes wrong.
stages.whoA: His wife, killed by his failed experiment.
stages.whoB: Her husband, a devoted scientist.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Curt Connors and Otto Octavius are friends and fellow scientists.
stages.whoA: A friend and fellow scientist.
stages.whoB: His friend, the fusion scientist.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, Otto recognizes the Goblin as Norman Osborn, a man he thought was dead. After Otto is cured, the Goblin turns on him, and at the Statue of Liberty he slices off one of Otto's arms.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, back from the dead and against him.
stages.whoB: Otto Octavius, a scientist from his world who stands against him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: When the Goblin turns the villains against Peter, Max blasts Otto out of the building. At the Statue of Liberty, Otto tears the arc reactor from Max's chest and puts the cure in its place.
stages.whoA: Electro, who blasts him, then gets cured by him.
stages.whoB: Doc Ock, who pulls out his reactor and cures him.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Eddie Brock, as Venom, proposes that he and the Sandman team up to kill Spider-Man. Together they take Mary Jane hostage as bait.
stages.whoA: Venom, his partner in a plan to kill Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: The Sandman, whom he recruits to kill Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Flint Marko is the man who shot Ben Parker. He later says the gun went off by accident while he was trying to get away.
stages.whoA: The man he shot by accident during a carjacking.
stages.whoB: His real killer, who says the shot was an accident.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Dennis Carradine was Flint Marko's accomplice in the carjacking that killed Ben Parker.
stages.whoA: His accomplice in the carjacking that killed Ben.
stages.whoB: His partner in the carjacking, who fired the shot.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: When Otto is cured in Happy Hogan's apartment, the Goblin persuades Marko to turn against Peter and escape.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who talks him into turning on Peter.
stages.whoB: The Sandman, one of the villains he turns against Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: When Otto is cured, the Goblin persuades Max to turn against Peter, and Max steals an arc reactor to power himself up.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who talks him into turning on Peter.
stages.whoB: Electro, one of the villains he turns against Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Dennis Carradine robs a wrestling promoter, then carjacks Ben Parker and shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The carjacker who shoots him.
stages.whoB: The man he shoots and robs of his car.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Police reveal that Carradine was only the accomplice, and that his partner Flint Marko fired the shot that killed Ben.
stages.whoA: The accomplice in the carjacking that killed him.
stages.whoB: The man his partner shot in the carjacking.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: John Jameson is J. Jonah Jameson's son, an astronaut, and he gets engaged to Mary Jane.
stages.whoA: His son, the astronaut.
stages.whoB: His father, the Bugle's publisher.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Robbie Robertson is an editor at the Daily Bugle who works under Jameson and keeps a calm head beside him.
stages.whoA: His editor at the Bugle.
stages.whoB: His boss, the Bugle's publisher.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Betty Brant is Jameson's secretary at the Daily Bugle, taking his curt orders.
stages.whoA: His secretary.
stages.whoB: Her boss, the Bugle's publisher.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Ted Hoffman is a nervous Daily Bugle staffer who fields Jameson's shouted orders, and Jameson shoots down his ideas.
stages.whoA: A nervous staffer he bullies.
stages.whoB: His shouting boss.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Eddie Brock is a freelance photographer who flatters Jameson for a staff job. When his Spider-Man photo is exposed as a fake, Jameson fires him.
stages.whoA: A freelancer he fires for a fake photo.
stages.whoB: The boss who fires him.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Captain George Stacy is Gwen's father. He watches Spider-Man save her from a fall and makes sure the hero is honored for it.
stages.whoA: Her father, an NYPD captain.
stages.whoB: His daughter.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Gwen is dating Eddie Brock, who calls her his girlfriend and takes photos of her for her modeling. It does not last.
stages.whoA: Eddie Brock, whom she briefly dates.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, for a short time.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Gwen Stacy is Peter's classmate, and she returns his feelings. He tells her he is Spider-Man, and she makes the antidote that cures the Lizard, but her dying father asks Peter to stay away from her.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, who knows his secret.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, Spider-Man, whom her father asks to stay away.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Gwen breaks up with Peter over his guilt about her father, then they reconcile and he plans to follow her to Oxford. She helps him beat Electro, and she dies in a fall during his fight with the Green Goblin.
stages.whoA: The love of his life, whom he cannot save.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, who cannot save her from the fall.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Captain George Stacy is Gwen's father, and he hunts Spider-Man as a menace. When he learns Peter's secret, he lets him go after the Lizard and fights beside him, then dies asking Peter to stay away from Gwen.
stages.whoA: Gwen's father, who hunts him, then fights beside him.
stages.whoB: His daughter's boyfriend, the vigilante he hunts, then trusts.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: May is Peter's aunt, who raises him with Ben after his parents leave. After Ben is killed, she worries over Peter's late nights and injuries.
stages.whoA: His aunt, who raised him.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, whom she raised.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Studying to be a nurse, May tells Peter what she knows about his father.
stages.whoA: His aunt, who tells him what she knows of his father.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, who wants the truth about his father.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Ben is Peter's uncle and Richard's brother, and he raises Peter with May. After an argument, Ben goes out searching for Peter and is shot by a thief.
stages.whoA: His uncle, killed while searching for him.
stages.whoB: His nephew, his brother's son, whom he raises.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard Parker is Peter's father, who leaves him with Ben and May and flees when Peter is a boy.
stages.whoA: His father, who left him with Ben and May.
stages.whoB: His son, left with Ben and May.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Peter finds his father's recorded message, which reveals that Richard fled because he would not make weapons for Oscorp. Richard died when his jet was hijacked.
stages.whoA: His father, who refused to build weapons for Oscorp.
stages.whoB: His son, who finds his recorded message.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Mary Parker is Peter's mother, who leaves him with Ben and May and flees with Richard.
stages.whoA: His mother, who left him as a boy.
stages.whoB: Her son, left with Ben and May.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Mary died with Richard when their jet was hijacked and crashed.
stages.whoA: His mother, who died with his father in a plane crash.
stages.whoB: Her son, left behind when she and Richard died.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Ben and May are married and raise their nephew Peter. Ben is killed by a thief while searching for him.
stages.whoA: His wife, who raises Peter with him.
stages.whoB: Her husband, killed by a thief.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard Parker is Ben's brother, who leaves his son Peter in Ben and May's care. Ben later tells Peter about his father's work.
stages.whoA: His brother, Peter's father.
stages.whoB: His brother, who raises Peter.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard is May's brother-in-law, who leaves his son Peter in her and Ben's care.
stages.whoA: Her brother-in-law, Peter's father.
stages.whoB: His sister-in-law, who raises Peter.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Mary Parker is Ben's sister-in-law, who leaves her son Peter with him and May.
stages.whoA: His sister-in-law, Peter's mother.
stages.whoB: Her brother-in-law, who raises Peter.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Mary Parker is May's sister-in-law, who leaves her son Peter with May and Ben.
stages.whoA: Her sister-in-law, Peter's mother.
stages.whoB: Her sister-in-law, who raises Peter.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard and Mary Parker are married. Together they leave their son Peter with Ben and May and flee.
stages.whoA: His wife, who flees with him.
stages.whoB: Her husband, who flees with her.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Richard and Mary die together when their jet is hijacked and crashes.
stages.whoA: His wife, who dies with him.
stages.whoB: Her husband, who dies with her.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Flash Thompson bullies Peter at school. After Ben's death, Flash offers him sympathy, and he cheers for Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: A school bully who softens after Ben's death.
stages.whoB: The kid he bullies, then comforts.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: A thief robs a store, and in a struggle in the street he shoots Ben Parker. Peter hunts for him as Spider-Man but never finds him.
stages.whoA: The thief who killed Uncle Ben, never found.
stages.whoB: The boy who hunts him for killing Ben.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Ben tries to stop a thief fleeing a store, and the thief shoots him in the struggle.
stages.whoA: The thief who shoots him in a struggle.
stages.whoB: The man he shoots while escaping.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Curt Connors was Richard's partner, and Peter gives him his father's missing equation. Connors becomes the Lizard, and Peter fights him until the antidote turns him back, and Connors saves Peter from a fall.
stages.whoA: His father's old partner, who becomes the Lizard.
stages.whoB: Richard's son, who gave him the formula, then fights him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, the Lizard is caught and held in the Sanctum. Peter makes the antidote that cures him at the Statue of Liberty.
stages.whoA: The Lizard again, cured with Peter's antidote.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man from his own world, who makes his cure.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Spider-Man saves Max Dillon's life, and the lonely engineer comes to idolize him. Transformed into Electro, Max turns on him in Times Square, and Peter and Gwen overload him at a power station.
stages.whoA: Max Dillon, a fan who becomes Electro.
stages.whoB: His idol, Spider-Man, who becomes his enemy.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, Max fights the Spider-Men until Otto cures him. Afterward, Max and Peter share a friendly talk.
stages.whoA: Max again, cured and on friendly terms.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man from his world, now on friendly terms.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Harry Osborn is Peter's childhood friend, back in town to see his dying father. The two pick up their old friendship.
stages.whoA: His childhood friend, back in his life.
stages.whoB: His childhood friend, back in his life.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Dying of his father's illness, Harry demands Spider-Man's blood, and Peter refuses. Harry becomes the Green Goblin, learns Peter is Spider-Man, and Gwen dies in their fight.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, the friend who caused Gwen's death.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who refuses him the blood he needs.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Spider-Man stops Aleksei Sytsevich hijacking an Oscorp truck and has him arrested. Months later, Sytsevich returns in a rhino battle suit and calls him out, drawing Peter back into the mask.
stages.whoA: A Russian thug he jails, then faces as the Rhino.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who jails him, then faces him again.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: In a world not his own, Peter faces another world's Green Goblin at the Statue of Liberty. He throws that world's Peter the anti-serum that cures Norman.
stages.whoA: Another world's Green Goblin, whom he helps cure.
stages.whoB: A Spider-Man from another world who helps cure him.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Captain George Stacy is Gwen's father. He dies fighting the Lizard and asks Peter to keep Gwen out of danger.
stages.whoA: His daughter.
stages.whoB: Her father, killed by the Lizard.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Captain Stacy holds off the Lizard on Oscorp Tower so Spider-Man can release the antidote, and the Lizard mortally wounds him.
stages.whoA: The Lizard, who kills him.
stages.whoB: The police captain he kills on Oscorp Tower.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Gwen works as an intern under Dr. Connors at Oscorp. When he becomes the Lizard, she makes the antidote that turns him and his victims back.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Oscorp, who becomes the Lizard.
stages.whoB: His intern, who makes the antidote that stops him.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Gwen meets Max Dillon at Oscorp and is kind to him on his birthday. After he becomes Electro, she helps Peter overload him.
stages.whoA: Max, an Oscorp coworker who becomes Electro.
stages.whoB: An Oscorp coworker who was kind to him, then stops him.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Gwen meets Harry at Oscorp, where he tells her Peter needs her. As the Green Goblin, he carries her to a clock tower, and she dies in the fall.
stages.whoA: Peter's friend, who becomes the Goblin and causes her death.
stages.whoB: Peter's girlfriend, whom he takes to the clock tower.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Rajit Ratha is Connors's superior at Oscorp. When Connors refuses to rush human trials, Ratha fires him and plans to test the serum on veterans, and the Lizard attacks him on a bridge.
stages.whoA: His Oscorp superior, who fires him.
stages.whoB: The scientist he fires, who becomes the Lizard.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Curt Connors and Richard Parker were partners and friends at Oscorp, working together on cross-species genetics.
stages.whoA: His old partner and friend, Peter's father.
stages.whoB: His old partner and friend at Oscorp.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Jailed after his defeat, Connors is visited by a man in the shadows who asks whether he told Peter the truth about his father. Connors says no and angrily tells him to leave Peter alone.
stages.whoA: A shadowy man asking about Peter's father.
stages.whoB: A prisoner who will not talk about Richard Parker.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Max Dillon knew Curt Connors as a scientist at Oscorp in their own world. Held together in the Sanctum, they later escape and face the Spider-Men at the Statue of Liberty.
stages.whoA: Max Dillon, from his Oscorp, held beside him.
stages.whoB: Curt Connors, a scientist he knew at Oscorp.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Norman Osborn is Harry's father, who tells him on his deathbed that his fatal illness runs in their blood. Harry inherits Oscorp when he dies.
stages.whoA: His father, who passed him a fatal illness.
stages.whoB: His son and heir, who inherits his illness.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Richard Parker worked for Norman Osborn at Oscorp. His recorded message reveals that he fled because he would not help Norman make weapons.
stages.whoA: His employer, whose weapons plan he refused.
stages.whoB: His scientist, who fled rather than make weapons.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Donald Menken frames Harry for covering up Max Dillon's accident and takes Oscorp from him. Harry returns with Electro and forces Menken to inject him with the spider venom.
stages.whoA: The executive who steals his company.
stages.whoB: The heir he frames and ousts.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Ousted from Oscorp, Harry frees Electro from Ravencroft, and Max helps him break back into the company.
stages.whoA: Electro, whom he frees to break into Oscorp.
stages.whoB: The man who frees him from Ravencroft.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Locked in Ravencroft after Gwen's death, Harry meets the Gentleman and tells him to start building a team.
stages.whoA: The Gentleman, who builds a team for him.
stages.whoB: His ally in Ravencroft, who wants a team built.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: The Gentleman frees Aleksei Sytsevich from prison and gives him a rhino battle suit.
stages.whoA: The thug he frees and arms with a rhino suit.
stages.whoB: The man who frees him and gives him his suit.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: At Ravencroft, Dr. Kafka runs painful experiments on the captive Max Dillon, who swears revenge.
stages.whoA: The Ravencroft doctor who experiments on him.
stages.whoB: His captive test subject at Ravencroft.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Eddie Brock bonds with the alien symbiote Venom while exposing the Life Foundation. Venom comes to like Eddie and turns against his own kind to protect Earth, and the two stay bonded, eating only criminals.
stages.whoA: The alien symbiote who lives inside him.
stages.whoB: His host, a fellow loser he grows fond of.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Eddie and Venom fight over Venom's need to eat people, and Venom leaves him. They make up to stop Carnage at Grace Cathedral, then go on the run together.
stages.whoA: Venom, who leaves him, then returns to fight Carnage.
stages.whoB: His host, whom he leaves, then makes up with.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Hunted for the Codex they carry, Eddie and Venom flee across the country. At Area 55, Venom gives his life to destroy the Codex and the Xenophages, and says goodbye to Eddie.
stages.whoA: His symbiote, who dies saving him.
stages.whoB: His host, whom he dies to protect.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Anne Weying is Eddie's fiancee, a lawyer. When Eddie uses her files to confront Carlton Drake, both lose their jobs and she leaves him, but later she bonds briefly with Venom to save him.
stages.whoA: His fiancee, who leaves him, then saves him.
stages.whoB: Her fiance, who cost her her job.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Now engaged to Dan, Anne stays close to Eddie and acts as his lawyer. She finds Venom and brings him back to Eddie, then is taken hostage by Carnage.
stages.whoA: His ex, still his friend and lawyer.
stages.whoB: Her ex, who still turns to her for help.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Dr. Dan Lewis is Anne's new boyfriend, and he examines Eddie when the symbiote makes him sick. He finds that it is harming Eddie's organs.
stages.whoA: Anne's new boyfriend, a doctor who helps him.
stages.whoB: Anne's ex, a patient who becomes a friend.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Dan Lewis is the doctor Anne dates after leaving Eddie.
stages.whoA: Her new boyfriend, a doctor.
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, a lawyer.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Anne and Dan are now engaged, and she breaks the news to Eddie.
stages.whoA: Her fiance.
stages.whoB: His fiancee.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Anne helps separate Venom from Eddie with an MRI machine, then bonds with Venom herself to free Eddie from Drake's men.
stages.whoA: Eddie's symbiote, whom she briefly hosts.
stages.whoB: Eddie's ex, whom he bonds with to save him.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: When Venom leaves Eddie, Anne finds him bonded to Mrs. Chen, talks him into forgiving Eddie and brings him back.
stages.whoA: Eddie's symbiote, whom she talks into going back.
stages.whoB: The woman who talks him into returning to Eddie.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Anne's firm defends Carlton Drake's Life Foundation until Eddie uses her files to confront him, and she loses her job. Later, bonded to Venom, she helps free Eddie from Drake's men.
stages.whoA: Her firm's client, whose men hold Eddie.
stages.whoB: The lawyer whose files Eddie uses against him.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Cletus Kasady and Frances take Anne hostage and hold her at the cathedral where they marry.
stages.whoA: Carnage, who takes her hostage.
stages.whoB: Eddie's ex, whom he takes hostage.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Frances and Cletus take Anne hostage and hold her at the cathedral where they marry.
stages.whoA: Shriek, who helps hold her hostage.
stages.whoB: Eddie's ex, held hostage at her wedding.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Mrs. Chen runs the corner store Eddie shops at, and the two are friends.
stages.whoA: The corner store owner, a friend.
stages.whoB: A regular at her store, and a friend.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Venom saves Mrs. Chen's store from a robber.
stages.whoA: The store owner he saves from a robber.
stages.whoB: The symbiote who saves her store.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: When Venom leaves Eddie, he hides in Mrs. Chen for a while, until Anne finds him there.
stages.whoA: His friend, and his host for a while.
stages.whoB: Eddie's symbiote, a guest inside her.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Mrs. Chen reunites with Eddie and Venom in Las Vegas, where she and Venom dance together.
stages.whoA: His friend and dance partner in Las Vegas.
stages.whoB: Her old friend, who dances with her in Las Vegas.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Dr. Dora Skirth, a Life Foundation scientist troubled by the human trials, helps Eddie break into the lab to expose Drake. Drake kills her for it.
stages.whoA: The scientist who gets him into the Life Foundation.
stages.whoB: The reporter she trusts to expose Drake.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Dora works for Carlton Drake at the Life Foundation. When he learns she helped Eddie, he exposes her to a symbiote that kills her.
stages.whoA: His scientist, killed for betraying him.
stages.whoB: Her boss, who kills her for betraying him.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Maria, a homeless woman, is Eddie's friend. He finds her held as a test subject in the Life Foundation, and she dies when her symbiote passes to him.
stages.whoA: A homeless friend, whose symbiote passes to him.
stages.whoB: Her friend, the reporter who finds her in the lab.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Eddie confronts Life Foundation founder Carlton Drake about his human trials and loses everything. Drake sends men to hunt him for the symbiote, and he dies when Venom wrecks his rocket.
stages.whoA: The billionaire he exposes, who hunts him.
stages.whoB: The reporter who exposes his trials.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Carlton Drake holds the symbiotes as test subjects, and he wants Venom back. Venom wrecks Drake's rocket, killing him and Riot.
stages.whoA: The man who caged his kind, killed with his rocket.
stages.whoB: The symbiote he wants back.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Riot is the leader of the symbiotes and plans to bring more of its kind to Earth. Venom turns against it and blows up its rocket.
stages.whoA: The leader of his kind, which he destroys.
stages.whoB: A lesser symbiote who turns against it.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Bonded to Carlton Drake, Riot battles Eddie and Venom to launch its rocket and is destroyed in the blast.
stages.whoA: The symbiote leader he fights with Venom.
stages.whoB: Venom's host, who fights it.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Riot bonds with Carlton Drake, and they plan to launch a rocket to bring more symbiotes to Earth.
stages.whoA: The symbiote he bonds with.
stages.whoB: Its host, who shares its plan.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Roland Treece is Carlton Drake's head of security, and he hunts Eddie on Drake's orders.
stages.whoA: His head of security.
stages.whoB: His boss, who sends him after Eddie.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Treece leads Drake's men in hunting Eddie for the symbiote.
stages.whoA: Drake's security chief, who hunts him.
stages.whoB: The reporter he hunts for Drake.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Treece hunts Eddie and the symbiote for Drake until Venom kills him.
stages.whoA: Drake's security chief, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: The symbiote who kills him.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Eddie interviews serial killer Cletus Kasady in San Quentin, and Kasady promises there will be carnage when he gets out.
stages.whoA: A serial killer he interviews in prison.
stages.whoB: The reporter he talks to from prison.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Kasady will talk only to Eddie, whose story gets him sentenced to death. At his execution he bites Eddie, takes in part of Venom and becomes Carnage, then hunts Eddie until Venom devours him.
stages.whoA: Carnage, the killer born from his bite.
stages.whoB: The reporter he blames, his target for revenge.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: When Kasady bites Eddie, he takes in a piece of Venom that becomes the red symbiote Carnage. Venom fights him at the cathedral and devours both Carnage and Kasady.
stages.whoA: Carnage, born from a piece of him, whom he devours.
stages.whoB: Venom, whose piece made him, and who devours him.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Frances Barrison helps Carnage hunt Eddie and Venom and takes Anne hostage. She dies in the cathedral battle.
stages.whoA: Shriek, Kasady's love, whom he fights at the cathedral.
stages.whoB: The reporter Carnage wants dead.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: At the cathedral, Venom goads Frances into screaming, and her sonic power tears Carnage away from Kasady.
stages.whoA: Shriek, whose scream he turns against Carnage.
stages.whoB: Venom, who tricks her into hurting Carnage.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Cletus Kasady and Frances Barrison love each other as children before she is taken away to Ravencroft. As Carnage, he frees her, and they marry at Grace Cathedral before she dies in the battle.
stages.whoA: Frances, his childhood love, whom he marries.
stages.whoB: Cletus, her childhood love, whom she marries.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Imperium researcher Sadie Christmas sympathizes with the symbiotes and frees Venom at Area 55. She then bonds with one of them to fight the Xenophages.
stages.whoA: The symbiote she frees at Area 55.
stages.whoB: The scientist who frees him.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Teddy Paine and Sadie Christmas are friends and fellow scientists at Imperium. When Area 55 explodes, Teddy bonds with a symbiote to shield Sadie.
stages.whoA: Her friend and fellow scientist, whom she saves.
stages.whoB: Her friend and colleague, who shields her from the blast.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: General Rex Strickland oversees Imperium, where Teddy studies the captured symbiotes.
stages.whoA: A scientist on his Imperium operation.
stages.whoB: The general who runs Imperium.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Strickland oversees Imperium, where Sadie works as a researcher. She goes against him by freeing Venom.
stages.whoA: A researcher who frees Venom behind his back.
stages.whoB: The general who runs Imperium.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: General Strickland hunts Eddie for the Codex and shoots him at Area 55. Mortally wounded, he has a change of heart and dies destroying the Xenophages.
stages.whoA: The fugitive he hunts and shoots.
stages.whoB: The general who hunts and shoots him.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Strickland hunts Venom and Eddie to destroy the Codex. At the end, he turns his grenades on the Xenophages instead.
stages.whoA: The symbiote he hunts.
stages.whoB: The general who hunts him and Eddie.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: When the Xenophages overrun Area 55, a mortally wounded Strickland sets off his grenades and destroys them.
stages.whoA: The creatures he dies destroying.
stages.whoB: The soldier whose grenades destroy them.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Knull created the symbiotes, and they imprisoned him. He sends the Xenophages to take the Codex from Venom, and Venom dies to destroy it.
stages.whoA: One of his own creations, carrying the Codex.
stages.whoB: The creator of his kind, who wants the Codex.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Knull wants the Codex that Eddie and Venom carry, and he sends the Xenophages after them.
stages.whoA: Venom's host, carrying the Codex he needs.
stages.whoB: The symbiote god hunting him for the Codex.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: The Xenophages are Knull's hunters, sent from his prison to retrieve the Codex.
stages.whoA: His hunters, sent after the Codex.
stages.whoB: Their master, who sends them to Earth.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: The Xenophages track Eddie and Venom across the country for the Codex, attacking them again and again.
stages.whoA: Their prey, carrying the Codex.
stages.whoB: Knull's hunters, tracking him for the Codex.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Venom fights the Xenophages across the country, then gives his life to drag them into the acid tanks at Area 55.
stages.whoA: The symbiote who dies to destroy them.
stages.whoB: Knull's hunters, whom he dies to stop.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Sadie bonds with a symbiote and fights the Xenophages when they attack Area 55.
stages.whoA: A scientist who fights them with a symbiote.
stages.whoB: The beasts she fights at Area 55.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Martin Moon and his family pick up Eddie and give him a ride to Las Vegas.
stages.whoA: A stranger he drives to Las Vegas.
stages.whoB: The alien fan who drives him to Las Vegas.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Michael and Milo meet as boys at a hospital in Greece, bonded by the same blood illness, and grow up as brothers. Years later, Milo funds Michael's search for a cure.
stages.whoA: His brother in all but blood, who shares his illness.
stages.whoB: His brother in all but blood, who seeks their cure.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Milo steals the cure, becomes a killer vampire and urges Michael to embrace what they are. After Milo kills Nicholas and attacks Martine, Michael stops him with the antibodies.
stages.whoA: His brother, now a killer he must stop.
stages.whoB: His brother, who refuses to become what he is.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Dr. Emil Nicholas is the adoptive father who raises Michael and Milo and sends Michael to medical school in New York. Milo kills him.
stages.whoA: His adoptive father, killed by Milo.
stages.whoB: The boy he raised, now a brilliant doctor.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Emil Nicholas raises Milo and cares for him as he grows up sick. When Nicholas begs him to stop killing, Milo, jealous of his love for Michael, kills him.
stages.whoA: His adoptive father, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: The son he raised and cared for, who kills him.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Dr. Martine Bancroft is Michael's colleague and the woman he loves. She helps with his cure and his antibody, and after Milo mortally wounds her, she wakes up changed by Michael's blood.
stages.whoA: His colleague and love, who helps with his cure.
stages.whoB: Her colleague and love, whose blood changes her.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Milo kidnaps Martine and mortally wounds her to lure Michael into a fight.
stages.whoA: Michael's love, whom he attacks to hurt him.
stages.whoB: Michael's brother, who mortally wounds her.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Constance Webb is Cassie's mother, a scientist shot by Ezekiel in Peru who dies giving birth to her. Cassie later learns her mother sought the spider to save her.
stages.whoA: Her mother, who died giving birth to her.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, born as she died.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ezekiel Sims killed Cassie's mother, and he hunts the three girls Cassie protects. She leads him into a trap, and he dies in the final fight.
stages.whoA: Her mother's killer, who hunts the girls.
stages.whoB: Constance's daughter, who protects the girls he hunts.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Cassie saves Julia from Ezekiel Sims and hides her with the other two girls. After the fight at the fireworks factory, Cassie vows to mentor them.
stages.whoA: One of the three girls she saves and will mentor.
stages.whoB: The paramedic who saves her and vows to mentor her.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ben Parker shelters Julia and the other girls at his home in Queens, then drives them along when he rushes Mary to the hospital.
stages.whoA: One of the girls he shelters for Cassie.
stages.whoB: Cassie's partner, who shelters her in Queens.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ezekiel Sims hunts Julia because his visions show her and two other girls killing him. She fights him with the others at the fireworks factory.
stages.whoA: The man who hunts her, fearing her future.
stages.whoB: One of three girls he fears will kill him.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Cassie saves Anya from Ezekiel Sims and hides her with the other two girls. After the fight at the fireworks factory, Cassie vows to mentor them.
stages.whoA: One of the three girls she saves and will mentor.
stages.whoB: The paramedic who saves her and vows to mentor her.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ben Parker shelters Anya and the other girls at his home in Queens, then drives them along when he rushes Mary to the hospital.
stages.whoA: One of the girls he shelters for Cassie.
stages.whoB: Cassie's partner, who shelters her in Queens.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ezekiel Sims hunts Anya because his visions show her and two other girls killing him. She fights him with the others at the fireworks factory.
stages.whoA: The man who hunts her, fearing her future.
stages.whoB: One of three girls he fears will kill him.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Cassie saves Mattie from Ezekiel Sims and hides her with the other two girls. After the fight at the fireworks factory, Cassie vows to mentor them.
stages.whoA: One of the three girls she saves and will mentor.
stages.whoB: The paramedic who saves her and vows to mentor her.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ben Parker shelters Mattie and the other girls at his home in Queens, then drives them along when he rushes Mary to the hospital.
stages.whoA: One of the girls he shelters for Cassie.
stages.whoB: Cassie's partner, who shelters her in Queens.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ezekiel Sims hunts Mattie because his visions show her and two other girls killing him. She fights him with the others at the fireworks factory.
stages.whoA: The man who hunts her, fearing her future.
stages.whoB: One of three girls he fears will kill him.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Julia and Anya are strangers until Ezekiel hunts them both. Hiding together with the third girl, they become friends and fight him side by side at the fireworks factory.
stages.whoA: A girl hunted with her, now a friend.
stages.whoB: A girl hunted with her, now a friend.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Julia and Mattie are strangers until Ezekiel hunts them both. Hiding together with the third girl, they become friends and fight him side by side at the fireworks factory.
stages.whoA: A girl hunted with her, now a friend.
stages.whoB: A girl hunted with her, now a friend.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Anya and Mattie are strangers until Ezekiel hunts them both. Hiding together with the third girl, they become friends and fight him side by side at the fireworks factory.
stages.whoA: A girl hunted with her, now a friend.
stages.whoB: A girl hunted with her, now a friend.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ben Parker is Cassie's paramedic partner and friend, and he revives her after she nearly drowns. Later he shelters the girls at his home in Queens.
stages.whoA: Her paramedic partner, who revives her.
stages.whoB: His paramedic partner and friend.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: O'Neil is Cassie's fellow paramedic and friend. He dies on a call, and Cassie realizes she foresaw it.
stages.whoA: A paramedic friend whose death she foresaw.
stages.whoB: His fellow paramedic and friend.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Santiago is the chief of the spider tribe Las Aranas, who tried to save Cassie's mother. He guides Cassie through a ritual that shows her the web of life and tells her that accepting responsibility will unlock her power.
stages.whoA: The tribal chief who guides her to her power.
stages.whoB: Constance's daughter, whom he guides.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: When Mary Parker goes into labor early, Cassie rescues the girls in an ambulance and holds off Ezekiel so Ben can get Mary to the hospital. Mary gives birth to her son as the injured Cassie arrives.
stages.whoA: Ben's sister-in-law, whom she helps reach the hospital.
stages.whoB: Ben's partner, who holds off Ezekiel for her.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Mary Parker is Ben's pregnant sister-in-law. He rushes her to the hospital when she goes into labor early, and she gives birth to her son.
stages.whoA: His pregnant sister-in-law.
stages.whoB: Her brother-in-law, who gets her to the hospital.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Ezekiel Sims is the man Constance hires to protect her team in the Amazon. He betrays her to steal the spider and shoots her, leaving her to die.
stages.whoA: The scientist he betrays and kills.
stages.whoB: The guard she hires, who kills her.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Amaria is Ezekiel's research assistant, a hacker who uses stolen NSA tools to track the three girls for him.
stages.whoA: His hacker assistant.
stages.whoB: Her boss, who sends her after the girls.

stages.title: Madame Web
stages.text: Santiago's tribe tries to save the dying Constance Webb with a spider's bite, but she dies after giving birth.
stages.whoA: The scientist his tribe tries to save.
stages.whoB: The chief whose tribe tries to save her.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Dmitri is Sergei's younger half-brother. Sergei is mauled by a lion protecting him as a boy and later rescues him from kidnappers, but Dmitri ends up taking over their father's empire as the Chameleon.
stages.whoA: His younger half-brother, who takes over their father's empire.
stages.whoB: His older half-brother, who protects and rescues him.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Nikolai Kravinoff is Sergei's cruel father, a crime lord who raises his sons to be hunters. Sergei breaks with him, and after learning Nikolai used his sons against Aleksei, he lures a bear to kill him.
stages.whoA: His cruel father, whom he lets a bear kill.
stages.whoB: His son, who breaks from him and kills him.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Nikolai Kravinoff is Dmitri's father, who scorns his timid son and refuses to pay his ransom when he is kidnapped. After Nikolai dies, Dmitri takes over his empire.
stages.whoA: His father, who will not pay his ransom.
stages.whoB: His timid son, who inherits his empire.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: As a girl, Calypso heals the wounded Sergei with a potion that gives him his powers. Years later, now a lawyer, she helps him rescue Dmitri, kills the Foreigner and revives him.
stages.whoA: The woman whose potion saved him, now his ally.
stages.whoB: The boy she healed, now Kraven.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Aleksei Sytsevich kidnaps Dmitri and uses him as bait to draw out Kraven. In their final battle, Aleksei turns into the Rhino, and Kraven kills him.
stages.whoA: The crime boss who kidnaps his brother.
stages.whoB: Kraven, whose brother he uses as bait.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Aleksei kidnaps Dmitri for ransom, then offers him a partnership against Nikolai and uses him as bait for Kraven.
stages.whoA: His kidnapper, who offers him a partnership.
stages.whoB: His hostage and bait, Nikolai's son.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Aleksei and his hired assassin ambush Calypso and Kraven at the sanctuary.
stages.whoA: The crime boss who ambushes her and Kraven.
stages.whoB: Kraven's ally, ambushed at the sanctuary.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: The Foreigner drugs Kraven at the sanctuary, and Calypso kills him with a crossbow.
stages.whoA: The assassin she kills with a crossbow.
stages.whoB: The lawyer who kills him with a crossbow.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Aleksei hires the Foreigner to kill Kraven. He disorients Kraven with hypnosis and drugs him with a neurotoxin before Calypso kills him.
stages.whoA: The hypnotic assassin hired to kill him.
stages.whoB: His target, Kraven.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Aleksei Sytsevich hires the Foreigner, an assassin who uses hypnosis, to kill Kraven.
stages.whoA: The crime boss who hires him.
stages.whoB: The assassin he hires to kill Kraven.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Kraven gets himself locked in a Russian prison to reach crime boss Semyon Chorney, then kills him in his private office.
stages.whoA: A crime boss he hunts in prison.
stages.whoB: The hunter who comes for him in prison.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Aleksei Sytsevich is a rival crime boss who wants to overthrow Nikolai. Nikolai knows Aleksei is after him and manipulates his sons into dealing with him.
stages.whoA: A rival crime boss out to topple him.
stages.whoB: The crime lord he plans to overthrow.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Ruby Williams is Ben's fiancee in the 1920s. She is killed by a criminal Ben once caught, and her death drives him to give up being the Spider.
stages.whoA: His late fiancee, killed by a criminal he caught.
stages.whoB: Her fiance, the Spider.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Robbie Robertson is Ben's friend, a journalist who digs into the same case. He pushes Ben to help the other metahumans, cures Lonnie Lincoln and even poses as the Spider to protect him.
stages.whoA: His journalist friend, who risks his life for him.
stages.whoB: His friend, the Spider.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Janet Ruiz is Ben's secretary and fellow investigator, and she works his cases with him. In the end she becomes his partner in Reilly and Ruiz Investigations.
stages.whoA: His secretary, then his partner in the agency.
stages.whoB: Her boss, then her partner in the agency.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Cat Hardy hires Ben to find Flint Marko while hiding her own plot against Silvermane. They fall for each other and she works out he is the Spider, but she gives his secret to Dr. Faber, then confesses her betrayal to save his life.
stages.whoA: His client and lover, who betrays him, then saves him.
stages.whoB: The private eye she hires, falls for and betrays.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Silvermane rules New York's underworld, and Ben keeps crossing him on his case. As the Spider, Ben scares him into leaving him and Janet alone, but Silvermane later captures Ben and learns who he is.
stages.whoA: The mob boss he keeps crossing.
stages.whoB: The private eye who turns out to be the Spider.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Flint Marko is Cat's bodyguard, and she hires Ben to find him after he disappears. Marko fights Ben as Silvermane's enforcer, but in the end Ben gives him the last dose of the cure so he can be with Cat.
stages.whoA: Cat's lover and bodyguard, who gets Ben's last cure.
stages.whoB: The private eye who gives up his cure for him.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Lonnie Lincoln is one of Silvermane's powered enforcers, and he fights the Spider. Once Robbie cures him, he helps Ben get away from the police and thanks him before leaving town.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, an enforcer he fights, then helps cure.
stages.whoB: The Spider, who fights him, then helps free him.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Dirk Leyden is an electric criminal the Spider beats in the Diamond District. He joins Silvermane and recognizes Ben from the war, and the Spider throws him into an oncoming train.
stages.whoA: An electric criminal he beats, then kills.
stages.whoB: The Spider, who beats him twice.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Dr. Faber treated every metahuman before their powers worsened. Hoping to cure her son, she has Ben brought to her lab and operates on him, but Ogden lets him escape.
stages.whoA: The doctor who operates on him for her cure.
stages.whoB: The Spider, whose body holds her cure.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Ben is hired to find Jimmy Addison, a crook with fire powers. When they corner him, another investigator shoots Jimmy dead.
stages.whoA: A fire wielding crook he is hired to find.
stages.whoB: The private eye who hunts him.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Robbie seeks out Lonnie Lincoln for his story and interviews him. Later he injects the cure into Lincoln's eye, and Lincoln thanks him and urges him to find another place to report than the Daily Bugle.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, whom he cures with Ben's antidote.
stages.whoB: The journalist who cures him.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Robbie digs into Silvermane's empire for his stories. At the Alcove, he arrives dressed as the Spider to stop Silvermane from killing Cat.
stages.whoA: The mob boss he investigates and tricks.
stages.whoB: A journalist who poses as the Spider.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Robbie traces the metahumans to Dr. Faber and questions her and her secretary, Ogden.
stages.whoA: The doctor his story leads him to.
stages.whoB: A journalist asking about her patients.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: When Robbie poses as the Spider, Dirk Leyden injects him with the cure and electrocutes him. Robbie survives.
stages.whoA: The electric thug who nearly kills him.
stages.whoB: The fake Spider he shocks.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Robbie and Janet work together on Ben's case, tracing the metahumans to Dr. Faber and interviewing Lonnie Lincoln.
stages.whoA: Ben's secretary, who works the case with him.
stages.whoB: Ben's journalist friend, who works the case with her.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Silvermane's men threaten Janet, which drives Ben to become the Spider again. Later they follow her to capture Ben.
stages.whoA: The mob boss whose men threaten her.
stages.whoB: Ben's secretary, a way to get to him.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Silvermane owns the Alcove, where Cat sings, and he murdered her first fiance. She secretly plots against him, and in the end she tracks him down and kills him.
stages.whoA: The boss who killed her fiance, whom she kills.
stages.whoB: His singer, who plots to kill him.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Cat Hardy and Flint Marko are lovers who hope to settle down together. He turns away when he learns what she hid from him, but he protects her from Leyden, and Ben's last cure lets them be together.
stages.whoA: Her bodyguard and lover.
stages.whoB: His lover, the singer he guards.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Cat secretly hires Jimmy Addison to kill Silvermane, and he burns down Silvermane's mansion.
stages.whoA: The crook she hires to kill Silvermane.
stages.whoB: The singer who hires him to kill Silvermane.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Told that seeing the Spider may help Dr. Faber find a cure, Cat gives her Ben's secret.
stages.whoA: The doctor she gives Ben's secret to.
stages.whoB: The singer who tells her who the Spider is.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Dirk Leyden attacks Cat, and Marko turns on him for it.
stages.whoA: The electric thug who attacks her.
stages.whoB: Marko's lover, whom he attacks.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Lonnie Lincoln is Flint Marko's friend, a fellow former prisoner of war with powers. Marko hides with him when his condition worsens, and later brings him to work for Silvermane.
stages.whoA: His friend, who hides him.
stages.whoB: His friend, who brings him into Silvermane's crew.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Flint Marko once worked as Silvermane's enforcer. Feeling betrayed by Cat, he goes back to Silvermane and becomes his right-hand man.
stages.whoA: The mob boss he works for.
stages.whoB: His right-hand man.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Marko frees Dirk Leyden to join Silvermane's crew. When Leyden attacks Cat, Marko turns on him.
stages.whoA: The electric thug he frees, then turns on.
stages.whoB: The man who frees him, then betrays him.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Lonnie Lincoln serves Silvermane as one of his powered enforcers.
stages.whoA: The mob boss he works for.
stages.whoB: One of his powered enforcers.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Freed by Marko, Dirk Leyden joins Silvermane's crew and attacks his enemies. He later tries to get Marko to help him overthrow Silvermane.
stages.whoA: The mob boss he serves, then plots against.
stages.whoB: His electric enforcer.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Dr. Faber treated Dirk Leyden before his powers grew worse. When Silvermane's crew storms her lab, Leyden kills her and her son.
stages.whoA: His old doctor, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: Her former patient, who kills her.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Silvermane storms Dr. Faber's lab looking for more metahumans to join his crew, and she dies in the attack.
stages.whoA: The doctor whose lab he raids.
stages.whoB: The mob boss who raids her lab.

stages.title: Spider-Noir
stages.text: Jimmy Addison once worked as an enforcer for Silvermane, then is paid to burn down his mansion.
stages.whoA: His former enforcer, who burns his mansion.
stages.whoB: His old boss, whose mansion he burns.
